t: Sandtex 10Ltr Fine Textured Ivory Stone Masonry Paint provides robust and lasting protection for exterior surfaces. This water-based masonry paint is perfect for refreshing tired house walls, garages, or garden buildings, ensuring a durable finish. Formulated with Microseal Technology, the creamy texture covers fine cracks and delivers a dirt-resistant and waterproof coating, keeping masonry looking pristine. The breathable finish helps to prevent moisture build-up, and it is touch-dry and recoatable in just 3-4 hours, making exterior painting projects efficient. Suitable for application on concrete, pebble-dash, render, and stone.
b: Suitable for Concrete, Pebble-Dash, Render & Stone
